title: Galvor Scout, part 2: clean numbers, wrong tone is still a brand risk
hook: A creator with clean numbers and the wrong tone is still a brand risk.
caption:
A creator with clean numbers and the wrong tone is still a brand risk.
Most shortlists only check the numbers.

In 8,673 creator checks with Galvor Scout, 66% of the creators we turned down missed something the brand had said it must have.

The reverse happens too. 38% of creators whose content looked like a strong fit were moved down once we read their engagement.

As a CMO, I would rather hear that before the contract than after the post goes live.

Follow Galvor for what we keep learning from these checks.
